purpose: Verify the live BM-R1 candidate, independently recompute its run-package and maximum-FFE arithmetic, and identify cross-artifact identity risks before asking the author to select parameters. This audit does not choose parameters, amend a frozen artifact, prepare or freeze the BM package, execute an expected-red test, install a package, call an optimizer/evaluator or consume formal FFE.

consistency_scan.scope: Active live governance, preregistration, plan specification, Stage-5 amendment artifacts, Stage-6 readiness/authorization candidates and .light consistency registries; frozen snapshot copies and ZIP payloads excluded from lexical duplicate counting.

current_evidence.fact: LABEL_PERM permutes graph-node labels while preserving graph statistics and is a preregistered H1 comparator.
LABEL_PERM is a registered fairness control.
The original mechanism matrix contains seven variants including LABEL_PERM.
The frozen NV amendment mandates RAY_STYLE, DIV_MATCH, DEG_REWIRE and RANDOM_LABEL.
RANDOM_LABEL randomizes community identity while preserving activation frequency and group-size distribution.
RANDOM_LABEL is declared distinct from I3, RAY_STYLE, DIV_MATCH and DEG_REWIRE, but no relation to LABEL_PERM is declared.
Neither registry defines LABEL_PERM, RANDOM_LABEL or an alias/replacement relation between them.

finding.negative_result_boundary: The focused scan found no explicit author-confirmed statement that LABEL_PERM and RANDOM_LABEL are aliases, that one replaces the other, or that both must coexist. Absence of such a statement is a governance gap, not proof that the mechanisms are mathematically different.
downstream_consequences: If they are aliases, adding RAY_STYLE to the original seven-variant matrix gives eight variants.
If RANDOM_LABEL replaces LABEL_PERM, the matrix can also remain at eight variants after adding RAY_STYLE, but the H1 comparator wording and result-schema identity require a versioned amendment.
If they are distinct and coexist, the internal mechanism matrix has nine variants, invalidating the current eight-variant M/C1 resource arithmetic and requiring new run-package/FFE totals.
The H1 comparison identity, S6-E0 adapters, result schema and statistical-analysis contract cannot be finalized without an author decision.

resource_gate.interpretation: Selecting BM-R1 resolves the proposed modern-matrix dimensions, instances, seeds, budget, restart, roster and start policy. It does not measure throughput, authorize dependency installation or establish an execution GO.

actions_not_taken: No frozen, candidate, source, test or analysis byte was edited by the consistency scan.
No control alias, replacement or coexistence relation was selected.
No package was installed or downloaded.
No optimizer, evaluator, benchmark, objective or constraint function was called.
No formal result was read, generated or analyzed.
No performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, objective-novelty or paper-readiness conclusion was formed.
